_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Pemain Ular pada {width}×{height} grid.
Kamu mengontrol ular {player_id}. Gerakan sah: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (atau w/s/a/d).
Tujuan: bertahan hidup paling lama atau menjadi yang paling panjang dan mendapatkan skor tertinggi (batas giliran {max_turns} giliran).

game_action.invalid_death: Ula {player_id} maningga karano indak sah pamindahan.

outcome.survived_win: Pamain {player_id} batahan; sadonyo nan lainnyo mati.
outcome.turn_limit: Bateh giliran alah digunoan - skor paliang baiak manang tie-break.
